caption: The drawing features a cream or light beige background framed by a thin red border. At the center are two brown anchors crossed diagonally, with a brown and red rope entwined around them. Above the anchors to the left is a small black object that appears to be a coiled rope or hat with two tassels hanging down. At the top right, there is a blue object resembling a jacket or shirt with black dots outlining the design. In the lower right corner, there is a pair of blue trousers with black buttons or stitching at the waist and pockets. In the lower left corner, there is a brown ship's wheel with eight spokes. Centered below the anchors, the name "John Guion" is written in cursive red ink. The composition is arranged with the five distinct objects evenly distributed around the crossed anchors and name in the center.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
